final_artifacts: all workspace deliverables and raw byte hashes

model_settings.actual: reported source value or unknown; never inferred from parent
model_settings.requested: same native CLI defaults with explicit sandbox/config isolation

money.absent: unknown; no inferred zero or price calculation
money.source: only provider-reported amount with exact event pointer

rules: cached input is subset of input, not added again
reasoning count is subset if provider defines it; do not add speculatively
failed/partial invocation cost remains recorded, not discarded
tokens.source: actual turn.completed usage in retained vendor.stdout JSONL

tool_calls.count_rule: one completed item per exact id; retain failed/repeated commands; separate command/file/MCP/search/etc. kinds and unknown kinds
